_comment: Canonical tag vocabulary for evaluate REPORT-REVIEW. Each discrepancy (a paper finding the run missed, or a run finding absent from the paper) gets one or more ROOT_CAUSE tags and exactly one GRADING tag from the list matching its direction.

CAUSE_TAG.description: The design never planned a step that could have produced this finding.
The dataset the paper used is not in the datalake, so the finding was unreachable.
Other or additional data was analysed (different cohort, subset, modality, or more samples).
Analytical choices diverged — method, model, statistical test, thresholds, covariates, normalisation.

Different resolution of analysis: cell type vs. cell state/subcluster; gene vs. transcript/isoform; individual gene vs. pathway or module; peak vs. region vs. gene-level (ATAC); protein vs. peptide vs. PTM site; variant vs. gene-burden (genetics); taxon rank (microbiome); cell vs. sample vs. donor as the unit of aggregation; raw timepoints vs. binned stages.
The raw results are present but prioritisation, weighting of prior knowledge, or the conclusion drawn from them differs.

Attempted with the right data, resolution and method, and still did not recover it — bug, wrong test, or a silently swallowed error. The bucket with no excuse in it; a near-zero rate across cases means the evaluator is rationalising rather than grading.

missed.description: Present but hedged, smaller in effect, or partial. Counts as recovered-with-caveat, not as a miss.
The run found the opposite direction.

novel.description: Goes deeper along an axis the paper already opened.
A new axis the paper did not examine.
Contradicts the paper outside its enumerated findings (a contradiction of an enumerated finding is CONTRADICTED on the missed side, not a novel finding).
Likely technical rather than biological — batch effect, doublets, ambient RNA, dying/mito-high cells, DE driven by one donor. Novel only because the paper's QC removed it.
